messages.subject: Hollis — reference request from prospective employer
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

We've had a reference request for Gareth from a recruiter acting for a SaaS business. Can you confirm we just use the agreed form at Schedule 1 of the settlement agreement and nothing more? I don't want to stray into the circumstances of his departure.

Diane
